eyebrow: A finite sum vs. an infinite one
code:
Episodic:    G_t = R_t+1 + ... + γ^(T-t-1) R_T
Continuing:  G_t = Σ (k=0 to ∞) γ^k R_t+k+1
             requires γ < 1 to converge
caption: For continuing tasks, γ < 1 isn't optional — it's what keeps the return finite.

eyebrow: Two different reasons an episode stops
caption: terminated = a real ending; truncated = an external cutoff like a time limit.
